CYCLE08: THE COMPLETE GENERAL-DIMENSIONAL MODULAR HARDY GRAM
Origin: foundational_transfer_sol, Sol/max, no descendants.
Date: 2026-10-09. Immutable upon first reported SHA256 freeze.
Status at this freeze: internally derived mathematical candidate. The complete
algebra and the finite generator representation are proved below. Fresh physical
and theorem-first adversarial reviews have not yet been received. No external,
formal, priority, infinite-dimensional, or optimal-constant claim is made.

EXACT PROPOSED THEOREM

Let sigma be a faithful density on a finite-dimensional Hilbert space B. Let
L_* be a finite-dimensional positive Schrodinger Markov generator: exp(-t L_*)
is CPTP for t >= 0 and L_*(sigma)=0. Put s=sqrt(sigma), d=s^(1/2), and
G(X)=d X d. Assume H=G^(-1) L_* G is HS self-adjoint. Equivalently the
Heisenberg generator is KMS symmetric at sigma. Let R be ANY finite untouched
quantum reference, and rho be ANY faithful density on R tensor B. Then

  J = Tr[(id_R tensor L_*)rho (log rho - I_R tensor log sigma)]
      >= pi E,
  E = Tr[sqrt(rho) (id_R tensor H) sqrt(rho)] >= 0.             (T)

All logarithms are natural. There is no lower bound on the eigenvalues of
sigma or rho and no information, rank, dimension, commutation, GNS/modular
covariance, primitivity, or classical-reference hypothesis. The generator is
fixed and linear. An arbitrary faithful reference density tau_R can be inserted
in the logarithm as log(tau_R tensor sigma); its contribution to J is exactly
zero, because the local generator is trace preserving. The E expression is
unchanged by such a reference choice. Constants are uniform in ALL finite
dimensions. Singular states and normal infinite-dimensional extensions are
outside this frozen theorem.

Supplied/acquired boundary and independence

The authorized tensor_frame_sol Cycle08 complete qubit proof supplies the
all-real Hardy kernel lemma and a three-point qubit congruence. Its exact file is
work/agents/tensor_frame_sol/cycle08_complete_qubit/COMPLETE_NONLINEAR_PI_PROOF.txt,
supplied SHA256 f7e13256a830e884d8f64e5ee5b2cff7c82ba40f7a88202db04c0c90b1e940e3.
The authorized variance_monogamy_sol general kernel identity gives a different
PSD term plus a remaining quadratic whose sign is not controlled. Exact file:
work/agents/variance_monogamy_sol/cycle06_weak_endpoint_review/
GENERAL_DIMENSIONAL_KERNEL_IDENTITY_ADDENDUM.txt. Thos

CYCLE08 UNIVERSAL NONLINEAR PHYSICAL MODULAR GRAM: EXPOSED AUDIT
Reviewer: covariant_review_sol. No descendants, scans, or frozen-file edits.
STATUS: PASS for the exact identity and universal finite-dimensional pi
inequality, relative to the independently audited full KMS representation
and all-real Hardy kernel. Complete finite amplification also passes.
This is internal mathematical validation, not external/formal validation or
a novelty/priority claim. Earlier independent star results retain their
separate attribution; this GENERAL audit is exposed, not a blind proof.

ORIGIN FREEZE
work/agents/root_cycle08/GENERAL_MODULAR_GRAM_ROOT_CANDIDATE.txt
SHA256 4c9f508361d218c6629912a0044dc47e7e052e560e459043fe1b47cc49c3734e
Source line numbers below refer to this exact immutable version.

1. Physical interface and full representation: PASS (lines11-17,69-71)

For faithful sigma=s^2, Gamma_s(Y)=s^(1/2)Ys^(1/2), the KMS implementation
H=Gamma_s L Gamma_s^{-1} is HS selfadjoint and exp(-tH) is CP. The state
generator is L^*=Gamma_s H Gamma_s^{-1}. For a single Hermitian noise it is
(C rho+rho C^*)/2-KrhoK^*, with C=s^(1/2)V s^(-1/2) and
K=s^(1/2)B s^(-1/2). The orientation in the candidate is correct.
The positive Heisenberg generator is
L(Y)=(C^*Y+YC)/2-K^*YK. Its antisymmetric C drift is the physical Hamiltonian
contribution and must be retained. It is retained throughout this proof.

The prior independent full finite representation is applicable: with
e=vec I and P=e^perp, conditional Choi positivity gives
C_cond=P J_(-H)P>=0. HS symmetry makes this invariant under vec X->vec X^*.
An eigenbasis real for that antiunitary gives Hermitian traceless Kraus B_j.
The remaining zero-P-block Choi matrix is |A><I|+|I><A|; HS symmetry forces
A-A^* to be an imaginary scalar, which cancels. Therefore
H={V,.}/2-sum_j B_j(.)B_j, with V=2Lyap_s^{-1}(sum_j B_jsB_j) from H(s)=0.
This spans ALL finite KMS-symmetric QMS generators. No GNS symmetry, modular
covariance, or conditional legality of Phi^* is inserted. The argument and
vectorization factors were independently established in immutable
cycle06_global_weak_bridge/BLIND_BASELINE.txt,
SHA256 4820ae45076e3497e3c93b9ae5de923d409d2dba382c3c9377fec3a9e0d4e898.

2. Modular products and physical L(U): PASS (lines19-27)

Let U=log s, [U,B_w]=wB_w. Then sB_w=e^w B_ws and B_(-w)=B_w^*.
On a product B_wB_v the total frequency is w+v. I

FULL FINITE-DIMENSIONAL KMS HERMITIAN-NOISE REPRESENTATION
Cycle08 narrow audit; independent of the withheld nonlinear endpoint proof.
Worker: algebra_proof_recon; inherited verified Sol/max; no descendants.
Status: PASS by two independent finite-dimensional derivations, with an exact
primary-source drift-sign correction. No external or formal validation claim.

0. Exact theorem, convention and scope

Let n>=1, M_n=M_n(C), sigma>0 with Tr sigma=1, s=sigma^(1/2),
u=s^(1/2). All inner products below are the unnormalized Hilbert--Schmidt
inner product <X,Y>=Tr(X*Y). Set

  Gamma(X)=s X s,    Psi=Gamma^(1/2),    Psi(X)=u X u.

Let (P_t)_(t>=0) be a continuous semigroup of unital completely positive maps
on M_n, and use the POSITIVE Heisenberg generator L:

  P_t=exp(-t L).

Assume only KMS symmetry, <X,P_tY>_sigma=<P_tX,Y>_sigma, where
<X,Y>_sigma=Tr(X*sYs). This is equivalent to L*Gamma=Gamma L, with * on
a superoperator denoting its Hilbert--Schmidt adjoint. No GNS symmetry,
commutation with the modular group, diagonal Kraus form, or special dimension
is assumed. Put

  H=Psi L Psi^(-1).

Then there are N<=n^2-1 Hermitian, Hilbert--Schmidt traceless matrices B_j
such that, for all X in M_n,

  H(X)=sum_j H_(B_j)(X),
  H_B(X)=(V_B X+X V_B)/2-B X B,
  V_B=2 Lyap_s^(-1)(B s B),    Lyap_s(V)=sV+Vs.

In particular the displayed sum contains the full generator, including all
Hamiltonian terms allowed by KMS symmetry. It is not a statement only about
the dissipative part of a chosen physical GKSL representation.

Conversely, any finite Hermitian B family with this formula gives a legal
sigma-KMS-symmetric QMS on M_n after the inverse transport, and each summand
separately does so. Each H_B is Hilbert--Schmidt selfadjoint and positive
semidefinite as a superoperator. The empty family gives the zero generator.

The theorem is about a full matrix algebra. An arbitrary proper finite
C*-subalgebra need not admit such a formula with B_j required inside that
subalgebra: on a diagonal C^2 every such H_B vanishes on the algebra, whereas
a two-state classical Markov chain need not vanish. This qualification does
not restrict finite-dimensional quantum systems on full M_n or their matrix
amplifications.

1. Facts before choosing a CP gauge

KMS symmetry gives

  H*=Psi^(-1) L* Psi=Psi L Psi^(-1)=H.

Both Psi and Psi^(-1) are CP maps: they are filters X->uXu and
X->u^(-1)Xu^(-1)
